claim: § Teaching Notes: 'Neither view shows everything' — the waveform can't tell you the kick's 60 Hz, the spectrum can't tell you when the transient hit.

pieces.what: One kick shown in the time view, then the spectrum, each with a question only the other view can answer; then the spectrogram as the third view
A point dragged in Cartesian and polar at once; a circle is one number in polar
